acceptanceCriteria: Review transition is rejected unless the Sprint is Active and every assigned task is eligible.
Status responses disclose the sole active Sprint and whether it changed.
Agent paths cannot close or verify a Sprint.
componentsAffected: Harden Sprint state transitions so active context and task readiness are verified rather than inferred.
testSteps: Transition-matrix regression tests and active-context tests.

workItem.title: Enforce active-sprint transition and completion guardrails
